scope: Exact-selector/exact-property conflicts within the same file and identical media/supports context. The original audit baseline is 5e81321. Different selectors, pseudo-state interactions and visual equivalence require the separate browser evidence.
interpretation: These were historical repeated declarations, overwhelmingly in erp.css, NOT 293 legitimate responsive variants. Dead assignments were removed from active source; no scanner suppression or whitelist was used to obtain zero.
cascade_rule: For an exact selector/property/context, !important wins over normal priority. Among matching equal-priority declarations the last supported assignment wins. Each retained winner stays at its original source position.

passes.scope: Only dead longhand declarations with identical selector, exact media/supports context, property and !important priority; no shorthand, print, keyframe, layer, vendor fallback or reset value edits. Active repository CSS is not modified.

Only dead declarations with identical selector, exact media/supports context, property and !important priority. Stable background, padding and border shorthands are included. No print, keyframe, layer, vendor fallback or reset value edits. Active repository CSS is not modified.

Only dead exact-selector/property/context assignments. !important wins over normal priority; among equal priority the final declaration wins. Winners remain at their original source positions. No print, keyframe, layer, vendor fallback or reset value edits. Active repository CSS is not modified.

exclusions: Print media and fiscal print files
revert, revert-layer, inherit, initial and unset reset values
Comments and nonempty declarations unrelated to the matching property
mechanical_cleanup.intervening_changes: Root applied focused visual corrections between passes, including focus consistency and replacement of PDV action palette literals with canonical tokens. File hashes identify each exact pass input/output.

after_cleanup.source_normalization: Root trimmed trailing whitespace after applying the final candidate; active source hashes remain recorded.
after_cleanup.ui_subsequent_root_token_substitutions: PDV primary action normal/hover styles now reuse shared success tokens; current source hash is recorded above.

resolved_visual_finding.finding: Purple !important focus styles bypassed shared blue focus.
resolved_visual_finding.resolution: Root removed overriding important focus styles before the mechanical cleanup; higher-specificity shared focus now controls the visible field.

limits: Zero exact-selector conflicts is a static source-cleanliness result, not proof that different selectors can never disagree.
CSS.supports validates syntax in the recorded Chrome version; it does not certify every browser engine or runtime state.
Visual viewport, focus, density, modal and print checks must be read in the separate browser evidence.
